shared_elements: incised linear framing border running around the edge of the slab
rectangular/panel enclosure formed of straight lines
central vertical axis line with a stepped or bracketed terminal at the base
engraved sign-like marks (script or symbol characters) in a linear row
justification: Both slabs show the same austere scheme: a marginal incised border following the shaped edge, an inner rectangular panel, and a single centred vertical-axis figure with cross-arms and a stepped/footed base, with small linear sign-characters set in bands along the margins. The main difference is that B's central element is a distinct arc/half-circle joined to the vertical stem with clear character rows filling it and both side margins, whereas A's inner motif is a plainer cross with a small pendant device and A's border is a doubled banded frame with rung-like divisions rather than legible signs.
